fixture_schema_status: Proposed fixture schema only. Production event/API mapping and metric definitions require approval.
expected_answers_scope: Two-session internal oracle only; full-dataset expectations are checked by validate_full_dataset.py.

privacy.full_fixture: Threshold eligibility and authorized reporting require separate verification.

claiming AI evaluation cases have passed

source_revisions.note: The exact preparation-guide and event taxonomy revisions used to construct these fixtures have not been verified. Dataset and fixture schema versions are documented separately.

observation_window.scope: Synthetic event timestamp range, not a production reporting window

dish_revision_note: Fictional documentation placeholders only; dish revision IDs are not present in event records and are not production identifiers.

initial_saved_state.replicated_sessions: Each replicated session inherits the empty initial Saved state.

session_completion_policy.completed: Explicit session completion event or approved inactivity-timeout rule.
session_completion_policy.unfinished: No confirmed completion event or approved timeout.
session_completion_policy.finalized_retention: Numerator: completed sessions that directly saved the dish and still have it Saved at completion. Denominator: completed sessions that directly saved that dish. Exclude unfinished sessions and completed sessions that never directly saved the dish. If the denominator is zero, the rate is null.
session_completion_policy.unfinished_retention: Exclude from finalized retention; report separately as pending.
session_completion_policy.existing_fixture_limitation: Current event fixture does not establish explicit session completion; existing final_saved assertions represent end-of-fixture state, not verified completed-session retention.
